history.title: Our History
history.p1: The formation and development of the Open Joint-Stock Company Commerce Bank of Tajikistan as a universal credit organization took place in the conditions of many years of activity in a competitive environment in the domestic banking services market.
history.p2: It began in 2006, when the Limited Liability Company 'Muzaffariyat' was formed, organizing banking activities in the form of a micro-loan organization based on license No. 001-2519 'A' from the National Bank of Tajikistan.
history.p3: In May 2016, the updated team of LLC MDO 'Muzaffariyat' rebranded, renaming the credit organization to LLC MDO 'Fardo'. A month later, the license from the National Bank of Tajikistan for banking operations was updated under number BMT No. 0000062.
history.p4: In October 2017, the credit organization, operating as a limited liability company, was transformed into a joint-stock company, replenishing its charter capital with the help of shareholders (a new shareholder) to a level that allows it to continue its activities as a bank. MDO 'Fardo' was transformed into OJSC Commerce Bank of Tajikistan, which was granted license No. BMT 0000085 by the National Bank of Tajikistan.
history.p5: The bank's development strategy for the near future is aimed at expanding the scope of non-cash payment systems, improving the technological platform, and introducing innovative products. For example, the 'FAVRI' technological platform allows individuals and legal entities to use a wide range of banking services remotely. By becoming participants in e-commerce, they gained the ability to pay for purchased goods and services via QR code, as well as to carry out many other operations outside the Bank's office.
history.p6: A new and innovative product was the mobile application 'Favri Intiqol', which currently has no analogue in the financial market of Tajikistan. It, being a unified addition to the 'Sberbank Online' application, has no user restrictions: holders of any cards issued by Russian banks can make instant money transfers to the Republic of Tajikistan through it. The development of this innovative technological solution became possible thanks to the bilateral project 'One Gateway - All Russia', which allowed mobile banking to become even more functional, universal, and convenient. Its unique novelty lies in the fact that it can be used by users of any cards of the Russian national payment system, as well as international payment systems.
history.p7: From the first days of its establishment in the credit organizations market, the bank has strived to provide high-quality and accessible financial services to the population, thereby supporting the development of small and medium-sized businesses in the country's regions.
history.p8: Commerce Bank, as a socially active bank, today keeps pace with innovative technologies, applying standardized procedures for access to microfinance in its relationships with clients, which helps to minimize possible credit risks.
history.p9: To date, 63 Banking Service Centers and 11 branches operate in the country. In the future, it is planned to open new Banking Service Centers and branches, which will make the Bank even more accessible at the regional level.

whatIsIt.title: What is the individual deposit insurance system?
whatIsIt.p1: The individual deposit insurance system is a set of measures aimed at protecting the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation upon the occurrence of an insured event at credit institutions that are members of the Individual Deposit Insurance Fund.
whatIsIt.p2: The goal of the individual deposit insurance system is to ensure the financial stability of the Republic of Tajikistan, including maintaining public confidence in the banking system.
whatIsIt.p3: The activities of the individual deposit insurance system are regulated by the Law of the Republic of Tajikistan "On Insurance of Individual Deposits". To ensure the effectiveness of the system, the Individual Deposit Insurance Fund (hereinafter - the Fund) operates. The Fund pays insurance compensation to depositors upon the occurrence of an insured event, maintains a register of member credit institutions, and manages the accounting and collection of payments from credit institutions.

fundGoals.title: The goals of the Fund are:
items: To protect the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation;
To strengthen public confidence in the banking system of the Republic of Tajikistan;

contactInfo.title: Contact Information
contactInfo.addressText: Head office of Commerce Bank of Tajikistan, 734000, Dushanbe, 37/1 Bokhtar St.

coverage.title: Level and Coverage of the Fund's Insurance Compensation
coverage.p1: Individual deposits are insured automatically and do not require the depositor to sign an insurance contract. The object of insurance is individual deposits in national and foreign currency, confirmed by bank deposit agreements and/or bank accounts of salary and pension cards and/or savings books.

notCovered.title: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, compensation for the following individual deposits is not paid:
items: deposits for which the credit institution has the right to offset against the depositor's debts;
deposits that are pledged as collateral;
deposits obtained through criminal means or seized by a court;
deposits that, according to the conclusion of the National Bank of Tajikistan, have worsened the financial condition of the credit institution;
deposits of affiliated persons of the credit institution;
deposits of partners of the audit company engaged as the auditor;
deposits of individuals holding more than five percent of the credit institution's shares;
deposits placed in foreign branches of the credit institution;
deposits equal to any amount of the depositor's outstanding debt;
deposits of less than 10 somoni;

compensation.title: Insurance Compensation
compensation.p1: An insured event is the compulsory liquidation of a credit institution by a court decision, which creates an obligation for the Fund to pay insurance compensation.
compensation.p2: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, the amount of compensation for deposits is as follows:
limits: in national currency, no more than 500 calculation indicators;
in foreign currency, no more than 350 calculation indicators;
compensation.p3: Deposits in national currency are compensated in national currency. Deposits in foreign currency are compensated in national currency at the official exchange rate of the National Bank of Tajikistan on the day of the insured event. Interest on deposits is not compensated by the Fund.

paymentProcess.title: Payment of Insurance Compensation
paymentProcess.p1: After an insured event occurs, the Fund publishes an announcement in the media about the agent bank, the place, time, and procedure for accepting applications for deposit compensation. The announcement is also posted at the entrance of the agent bank and on the Fund's official website, www.idif.tj.
paymentProcess.p2: Compensation payments begin no later than 14 calendar days after the insured event and are made through the agent bank in cash or non-cash form.
paymentProcess.p3: To receive compensation, the depositor must apply to the agent bank within one year from the date of the insured event and provide the following documents:

slides.title: 1. Research the Credit Institution
slides.content: Make sure that the institution where you want to place a deposit is a member of the individual deposit insurance system and has a Certificate of Membership.

slides.title: 2. Review the Deposit Agreement
slides.content: Carefully check that your name, passport details, address, and phone number are correctly stated in the agreement and always inform the institution of any changes.

slides.title: 3. Remember which deposits are not compensated
slides.content: Pledged deposits, deposits obtained through criminal means, or deposits of affiliated persons are not compensated.

slides.title: 4. Don't worry and be patient
slides.content: You have one year to receive compensation. Do not rush on the first day to avoid queues. The Fund may extend the application period for valid reasons.

intro.subtitle: JSC Commerce Bank of Tajikistan: A privileged position for employees benefits the entire company.
intro.p1: The salary project will free your organization from the need to withdraw cash from the account, count it, and disburse salaries to each employee in cash. In addition to saving time, this also ensures security – a very important aspect when delivering cash to the organization's office.
intro.p2: As for employee convenience, your staff will be able to receive their salaries through any ATM using payment cards 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, as well as make non-cash payments for goods/services through the 'Mobile Bank' and POS terminals installed at various retail and service points.

benefitsForCompany.title: Advantages of the Salary Project for Your Organization
items: Reduction of risks associated with receiving, storing, and transporting cash intended for employee payments
Reduction in the number of employees in the accounting and cashier departments
Elimination of salary queues
Provision of business trip expenses in a non-cash manner
Ensuring the confidentiality of individual salary information

Non-cash payments for goods/services through POS terminals installed at various retail and service points
Online card control, transfers, and service payments in the 'Mobile Bank' application and on the bank's website
Security of money on the card account if the card is lost
Receiving salary through ATMs 24 hours a day
Ensuring the confidentiality of account information
